## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
CAUTION: low volatility (Vol: 24.6%) but extremely narrow participation (Breadth: 0/8 sectors positive), signaling low-volatility distribution.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
No sector is positive; relative leaders are Banking and Holding on smaller losses: YKBNK (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND; GARAN (1W: +1.70% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY; SAHOL (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -5.85%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy & Chemicals, Technology & Telecom and Construction are the weakest: SASA (1W: -10.36% | 1M: -28.51%) BELOW TREND; KONTR (1W: -18.66% | 1M: -46.03%) BELOW TREND; TKFEN (1W: -23.77% | 1M: -21.71%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
TKFEN (1W: -23.77% | 1M: -21.71%) BELOW TREND; KONTR (1W: -18.66% | 1M: -46.03%) BELOW TREND; TRMET (1W: -12.60% | 1M: -9.09%) BELOW TREND; ULKER (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.33%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -10.36% | 1M: -28.51%) BELOW TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Cautious neutral within banks: YKBNK (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND; ISCTR (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -3.59%) RECOVERY; GARAN (1W: +1.70% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY; AKBNK (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.57%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Weak across heavy industry and autos: EREGL (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +0.33%) CORRECTION; FROTO (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -10.52%) BELOW TREND; TOASO (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND; VESTL (1W: -9.09% | 1M: -33.20%) BELOW TREND; ASELS (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Outright underperformance and selection risk: TUPRS (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -7.23%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -10.36% | 1M: -28.51%) BELOW TREND; GUBRF (1W: -9.83% | 1M: -12.19%) BELOW TREND; SISE (1W: -4.94% | 1M: -10.00%) BELOW TREND; TRMET (1W: -12.60% | 1M: -9.09%) BELOW TREND.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Trim cyclicals and high-volatility longs, maintain selective exposure to high-quality domestic banks (favor YKBNK and recovering GARAN/ISCTR) and reduce positions in beaten-up industrials and chemicals; keep cash/hedge for event risk given CAUTION regime.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
TKFEN (1W: -23.77% | 1M: -21.71%) BELOW TREND for follow-through and earnings/contract headlines; KONTR (1W: -18.66% | 1M: -46.03%) BELOW TREND on volatility; YKBNK (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND for relative strength; SAHOL (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -5.85%) RECOVERY for holding-driven moves.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Banking (look for idiosyncratic earnings/asset quality), Energy & Chemicals (margin and FX sensitivity), Technology & Telecom (risk of further derating).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch XU100 reaction to this week’s high/low for confirmation of distribution; key triggers are local CPI/CBRT guidance, TRY moves, corporate earnings (TKFEN, SASA), and global risk tone — break below weekly lows would accelerate downside.

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Low-volatility distribution: CAUTION regime as narrow participation masks selling pressure across all sectors. Opportunity set is selective: favor high-quality banks (YKBNK, GARAN, ISCTR) and stay away from high-volatility losers (TKFEN, KONTR, SASA) until breadth recovers or price structure improves.
